claim: Gene-expression profiles measured at diagnosis predict survival time in new patients: the out-of-sample R-squared for predicting survival_months from the expression profile is at least 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: log2 expression level of each gene in each patient's tumour sample
months from diagnosis to death, observed for every patient

claim: Expression profiles together with clinical covariates predict tumour response in new patients: the Pearson correlation between predicted and observed response is at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: log2 expression level of each gene in each patient's tumour sample
standardised clinical covariates of each patient (age, tumour size, and similar)
percentage tumour shrinkage measured after treatment

claim: A classifier built from the 12 measured variables recognises the positive class in new records with an F1 score for the positive class of at least 0.50.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the condition is present in the record

claim: A classifier built from the measured variables recognises both classes in new records: the balanced accuracy (the mean of sensitivity and specificity for the positive class) is at least 0.65.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the condition is present in the record

claim: A classifier built from the measurements detects the condition in new records: its sensitivity for the positive class is at least 0.60.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the condition is present in the record

claim: Gene-expression profiles allow tumour tissue to be distinguished from normal tissue in new samples: the classification error rate is at most 0.20.

data_keys.meaning: log expression level of each gene in each tissue sample
True for a tumour tissue sample, False for a normal tissue sample

claim: Gene-expression profiles allow the two classes to be told apart in new samples: the classification error rate is at most 0.40.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in each sample
True for a sample of class B, False for a sample of class A

claim: The monthly environmental measurements predict the abundance in later months of the series: the out-of-sample R-squared is at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: monthly abundance index of the species, on a log scale, in time order
monthly environmental measurements, in time order

claim: Habitat measurements predict vegetation cover at new sites: the Pearson correlation between predicted and observed cover is at least 0.40.

data_keys.meaning: habitat measurements of each plot at each site
vegetation cover measured in each plot

claim: Features computed from wearable-sensor signals recognise walking in newly recruited subjects: the classification error rate for walking versus other activities is at most 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: features computed from the sensor signal in each time window of each subject
True if the subject was walking during the window

claim: Gene-expression profiles predict five-year relapse in new patients: the area under the ROC curve is at least 0.70.

data_keys.meaning: log2 expression level of each gene in each patient's tumour sample
True if the patient relapsed within five years of diagnosis

claim: A classifier built from the measured variables ranks new records correctly: the area under the ROC curve for the event is at least 0.75.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the event occurred for the record

claim: Gene-expression profiles distinguish the two leukaemia types in new samples: the area under the ROC curve is at least 0.90.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in each bone-marrow sample
True for acute myeloid leukaemia, False for acute lymphoblastic leukaemia

claim: The daily driver measurements predict the daily river level in later days of the record: the root-mean-square error of the prediction is at most 0.70 standard deviations of the level.

data_keys.meaning: daily river level, in time order
daily measurements of the variables that may influence the river level, in time order

claim: Sensor measurements classify the disease status of newly recruited subjects: the area under the ROC curve of the classification is at least 0.70.

data_keys.meaning: sensor measurements of each recording of each subject
True if the subject has the disease
